import MumfordLib.SimplicialCochainGluing
import Mathlib.Algebra.Homology.ShortComplex.ModuleCat

/-!
# Degreewise cochain Mayer--Vietoris exactness

The restriction and overlap-difference maps on two simplicial subcomplexes are
exact in every degree. This is the degreewise algebraic producer for the later
short exact sequence of cochain complexes.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable {K : SSet} (A B : K.Subcomplex)

/-- The degree-`n` cochain Mayer--Vietoris short complex. -/
def simplicialCochainMayerVietorisDegree (n : ℕ) : ShortComplex (ModuleCat ℤ) :=
  ShortComplex.mk
    (ModuleCat.ofHom (simplicialCochainUnionRestriction A B n))
    (ModuleCat.ofHom (simplicialCochainIntersectionDifference A B n)) (by
      apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
      apply LinearMap.ext
      intro φ
      exact simplicialCochainIntersectionDifference_restriction A B φ)

/-- The degreewise Mayer--Vietoris short complex is short exact. -/
theorem simplicialCochainMayerVietorisDegree_shortExact (n : ℕ) :
    (simplicialCochainMayerVietorisDegree A B n).ShortExact := by
  apply ModuleCat.shortComplex_shortExact
  · rw [Function.Exact]
    intro x
    change simplicialCochainIntersectionDifference A B n x = 0 ↔
      x ∈ Set.range (simplicialCochainUnionRestriction A B n)
    change x ∈ LinearMap.ker (simplicialCochainIntersectionDifference A B n) ↔
      x ∈ LinearMap.range (simplicialCochainUnionRestriction A B n)
    rw [simplicialCochain_union_range_eq_ker]
  · exact simplicialCochainUnionRestriction_injective A B n
  · exact simplicialCochainIntersectionDifference_surjective A B n

/-- The degreewise Mayer--Vietoris maps are exact as functions.

This form exposes the producer relation without requiring callers to unpack
the categorical `ShortExact` wrapper.
-/
theorem simplicialCochainMayerVietorisDegree_exact (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Exact (simplicialCochainUnionRestriction A B n)
      (simplicialCochainIntersectionDifference A B n) := by
  intro x
  change x ∈ LinearMap.ker (simplicialCochainIntersectionDifference A B n) ↔
    x ∈ LinearMap.range (simplicialCochainUnionRestriction A B n)
  rw [simplicialCochain_union_range_eq_ker]

end Mumford.Analytic
